svg.title: Yunus: full-stack and cloud engineer
svg.desc: Pixel-art game title screen. A boot box loads the world to 100 percent, reads WORLD READY and turns into a blinking SCROLL TO PLAY button. The name YUNUS stamps in as big bitmap letters, then two lines type out: Full-stack and cloud engineer. Useful tools, playful worlds. Under a pixel moon, beside a small waterfall and pine hills, the red-hooded hero from Yunus's game walks along a dashed ground to a campfire, sits and says Let's build! A code bug pops out of its burrow and taunts him; he chases it, stomps it flat, grabs the coin it drops and the coin flies up into the HUD beside his flame health bar.
